CHIEF COMPLAINT
Numbness and tingling in fingers and wrist pain for several months.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
George is a patient presenting with right wrist and hand pain and numbness that has been ongoing for several months. He reports the symptoms started insidiously without an identifiable precipitating event. He notes the symptoms are worse at night, often waking with his hand asleep and requiring him to shake it out. The numbness appears to affect all fingers but is more pronounced in the thumb and pointer finger, with occasional numbness in the fifth finger. He denies similar symptoms in the right hand. Patient works in landscaping doing heavy labor with repetitive motions including raking and digging.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Denies right hand symptoms. Reports nocturnal numbness and paresthesias in left hand. Endorses weakness in left hand with difficulty gripping and dropping objects due to decreased sensation. No other systemic symptoms reported.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
No significant past medical history reported. Denies history of rheumatoid arthritis.

MEDICATIONS
Not documented.

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not documented.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient works in landscaping doing yard work and maintenance. Denies heavy alcohol use, reports consuming one to two beers on Friday and Saturday weekends.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Cardiac and lung auscultation normal. Grip strength decreased on left hand compared to right. Decreased sensation to touch on left hand, particularly on thumb side. Bilateral positive Tinel's sign elicited by percussion over wrist.

RESULTS
EMG study ordered to measure electrical impulses in fingers.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
Bilateral carpal tunnel syndrome suspected secondary to repetitive occupational labor. Plan includes activity modification with delegation of heavy repetitive tasks to employees for at least two weeks. Fitted with wrist splint for left hand. Ibuprofen 600 mg every six hours prescribed. Follow-up appointment in two weeks to reassess and determine need for further diagnostic testing or possible surgical intervention for nerve decompression.
